spec.situation_desc: couldn't pay a bill on time because the mobile app was down

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Imran Ellingham. The app was down yesterday and I couldn’t pay my electricity bill on time. I’m really fed up with the bank letting me down like this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry that happened, Imran. I’ll do my best to help. Before we discuss your account, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. I understand you couldn’t make the payment because the app wasn’t working. Don’t worry, we’ll get that charge refunded for you.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I’ve already had a late-payment fee from the electricity company. I shouldn’t have to deal with this because your app failed.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see why you’re annoyed, and I’m sorry for the hassle. I’ll check what happened with the payment and make sure the fee is returned.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: So you’ll look into it and get back to me?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. I’ll send this to our payments team today, and I’ll call you by Friday, 30th October, with an update. You’ll hear back within five working days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I just want to know what’s happening and not have to chase it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s fair. I’ll take ownership of it, and I’ll make the call myself by Friday, even if the team hasn’t finished looking into it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Just to check I’ve explained it clearly: I’ll ask the payments team to investigate the failed payment and fee, then I’ll call you by Friday with an update. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Imran. I’m sorry again for the trouble, and I’ll be in touch by Friday.
